verdict.rationale: Asana can be driven without its UI through its own documented interfaces: a RESTful JSON API with token-based authorization, official JavaScript and Python client libraries, webhooks, a published OpenAPI spec, and a developer sandbox for testing. Scripts and pipelines can automate it this way. However, there is no first-party CLI and no documented CI usage pattern, so CI use has to be assembled by the user from the API and SDKs. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or integrations (e.g. a first-party CI action), guidance on service-account/non-interactive auth for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
